name: Render API
tagline: REST API for Render PaaS — services, deploys, jobs, and databases
description: Render provides a REST API for managing cloud services, deploys, one-off jobs, databases, and infrastructure on the Render platform. Developers use it for Git-to-prod automation, CI/CD hooks, and programmatic control of web services, workers, and Postgres.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; create keys in Render Dashboard (Account Settings → API Keys).

pricing.free_tier_limits: 750 free instance hours per workspace monthly; web services spin down after 15 idle minutes. One free Postgres database per workspace (1 GB, expires after 30 days) and one nonpersistent free Key Value instance per workspace; bandwidth and build-pipeline limits also apply.

rate_limits: Endpoint-specific: 20/hour for service create/update/deploy/resume/suspend; 10/minute/service for deploy hooks; 50/hour for custom domains; 100/minute for jobs; 30/minute for logs and other writes; 400/minute for other GETs.
use_cases: list all Render services in an account
trigger a deploy for a web service
check deploy status for a service
